reviews.author: Kaif
reviews.text:
I booked this property for my friend, and overall the experience was fairly smooth. The check-in process was smooth, and the unit was clean and well-maintained. The kitchen and other facilities were also available.
However, the main issue was that the unit provided was different from the one booked, and a few basic amenities such as towels and tissues were missing. My friend also mentioned some issue with the lock on the gate. I informed the host as soon as I came to know about these issues, although I received a response only the following morning.
Since it was a short stay, I did not make a big issue out of it and asked my friend to manage with whatever was available. In fact, my friend had to order the missing essentials through Blinkit and manage them on his own. Apart from these points, the unit itself was clean and the overall stay was okay. Hopefully, the host can ensure that the listed unit and basic amenities are provided properly for future guests.

response.author: Response from Gourav
response.text:
Since your check-in was very late at night, I arranged my other property for you and had it prepared urgently. The place was prepared by a paid caretaker who is not my personal caretaker, so he wasn’t aware of where the towels and tissues were kept.
I apologize for the inconvenience. Next time, please try to book a little earlier, as this booking was made after 12 AM, which made it difficult to arrange everything properly at such short notice.
